items.title: George Avakian interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 21, 1998
items.q: I’ll tell you Monk, when I get rolling, it doesn’t stop

ctx.x: Well you know we’re going to have to do a Part Two, maybe in New York or something when we come there.

I’ll tell you Monk, when I get rolling, it doesn’t stop, and I haven’t said a tenth of the things that I was thinking of saying. MR. But I very much would like to get together with you again if it’s okay with you when we get to New York.
